description: Which skill should an agent load for each request? Labels are judged from each skill's name and description only, the text an agent sees before loading a skill. expected is the best skill; acceptable lists other skills that are also a correct first pick. expected null means no BlendOps skill should load.

cases.prompt: I want to make something in Blender but I have no idea where to begin. What do I do first?
We stopped halfway through the shoe scene yesterday. Pick it back up and tell me what is next.
Write the status update for our client, who has never used Blender, about where the 3D work stands.
Hôm qua làm dở cảnh 3D, giờ làm tiếp bước nào đây?
I kind of want a cool 3D thing for my landing page, maybe something techy? Help me pin down what it should be.
Can BlendOps even handle a full rigged character animation, or is that outside what it does?
Break my idea of an animated product unboxing into stages and find a recipe that matches.
Mình muốn có một cảnh 3D cho trang web nhưng chưa rõ làm gì, giúp mình chốt ý tưởng.
Before anyone opens Blender, write down exactly what has to be true for this hero render to count as finished.
The client now also wants a turntable video and a second colorway. Does that fit what we locked?
Set the stage gates for the product pack and check that its prerequisites are in place.
Trước khi làm, ghi rõ tiêu chí thế nào thì coi là xong cho cảnh này.
The plan is approved and Blender is connected. Go ahead and model the crate and add its materials.
Add the three lights and the camera from the plan to the open scene, then make a preview.
Everything is signed off. Export the chair as a GLB from the scene now.
Plan đã duyệt, Blender đã kết nối rồi, dựng cảnh theo plan đi.
Here is the first preview. Something looks off; check it and fix what is wrong.
The preview render is done. Look at it from a few sides and tell me if the bottle is floating.
Review the preview against the brief and fix the biggest visual problem, one at a time.
Có ảnh preview rồi, xem giúp chỗ nào nhìn sai thì sửa.
Plan a hero shot for our new wireless earbuds on a clean studio backdrop.
Lay out six sneakers in a catalog grid for the spring collection page.
Design a lineup scene with our three perfume bottles side by side.
Lên kế hoạch ảnh hero cho chai nước hoa mới.
Plan a cozy low-poly campsite at dusk with a tent and a campfire.
I need a character portrait scene of a knight for a poster. Plan the layout.
Plan a modern living room interior with a sofa, a window and evening light.
Lên plan cho cảnh nội thất phòng ngủ phong cách Nhật.
Which shots should we take of the watch, and should the output be 16:9 or square?
Choose a lens and framing so the shoe fills the frame with a bit of room on the right.
Does the current framing meet the composition rules we wrote in the brief?
Chọn góc máy và tỉ lệ khung hình cho ảnh sản phẩm này.
Set up a three-point light rig and a brushed metal material for the speaker.
Should we use AgX or Filmic for the view transform on this scene?
The glass material looks cheap. Plan better lighting and material settings.
Thiết lập ánh sáng và vật liệu kim loại cho cái loa.
Cycles or EEVEE for a quick social media clip of the bottle?
The compositor team wants EXR passes. What output format and settings do we pick?
Decide whether this delivery should be a PNG still, a video, or a GLB.
Nên render bằng Cycles hay EEVEE, xuất PNG hay video?
Find a free HDRI of a sunset sky that we are allowed to use commercially.
Check the license on this downloaded chair model before we put it in the ad.
Search for wood floor textures that fit a stylized look, with a backup if none fit.
Tìm texture gỗ miễn phí và kiểm tra license giúp mình.
Our GLB is 40 MB and takes forever on phones. What should the limits be?
Check whether this model's polycount and texture sizes are fine for mobile web.
Set a file size and triangle budget for the product viewer on our site.
File GLB nặng quá, load trên điện thoại chậm, giới hạn bao nhiêu là hợp lý?
Prepare this GLB for our web developers with notes on how to load it.
Document the animation clips in the robot GLB for the frontend team.
Plan a React Three Fiber component that shows the sneaker model.
Bàn giao file GLB cho team web kèm hướng dẫn dùng React Three Fiber.
Should I use the official Blender Lab MCP or mcp-for-blender with Blender 4.2?
Is my Blender connection ready? The agent cannot see the scene.
I have two Blender MCP bridges installed and they fight each other. Sort it out.
Kết nối Blender với agent bằng cách nào, dùng MCP hay chạy CLI?
Is the work actually done? Collect the proof that the render and export exist before we hand it over.
Write the runtime-attempt report for today's Blender session.
Verify the final render matches the done criteria before we send it to the client.
Kiểm tra lần cuối xem đã xong thật chưa trước khi bàn giao.
The render came out completely black. What went wrong?
The GLB export failed with an error about a missing texture.
In the browser the model shows up pink and the colors look wrong. Explain in simple words how to fix it.
Render ra toàn màu đen, lỗi gì vậy?
Write a Python function that sorts a list of dictionaries by date.
Fix the CSS so the navbar stays at the top of the page.
Summarize this quarterly sales spreadsheet.
Edit this photo in Photoshop to remove the background.
Draft an email asking the landlord to fix the heating.
Viết giúp mình bài đăng Facebook giới thiệu quán cà phê.
Set up a Postgres database for the user accounts.
Dịch đoạn văn này sang tiếng Anh.
